properties.site-address: Town Hall, The Boulevard, Northgate, Crawley
properties.notes: Hybrid planning application CR/2017/0997/OUT for a replacement of town hall, offices and residential development comprising of 182 units is approved subject to Section 106. A district energy centre to serve this development has already been approved under planning permission CR/2018/0139/FUL. Site is part of 'Land North of the Boulevard', which is allocated in Local Plan Policies EC6 (Development Sites within the Town Centre Boundary) and H2 (Key Housing Sites) as a 'Town Centre Opportunity Site' for residential development and/or main town centre uses.. https://planningregister.crawley.gov.uk/Planning/Display/CR/2018/0139/FUL|https://planningregister.crawley.gov.uk/Planning/Display/CR/2017/0997/OUT|http://www.crawley.gov.uk/pw/web/pub260100
